recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as the FHIR-20166 reconciliation. Do not edit source/genomicstudy/imagingstudy.svg for this issue unless GenomicStudy is separately brought back into the build and its copied diagrams are regenerated or reviewed as part of that work.
issue_request: FHIR-20166 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Imaging Integration change request for R5. It reported that ImagingStudy.procedureCode's ImagingProcedureCode value set linked to the obsolete RSNA RadLex Playbook page and requested changing the binding to the LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook FHIR value set; later Jira comments identified http://loinc.org/vs/loinc-rsna-radiology-playbook as the better canonical URL.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged batch commit b650c1dd54d447dcbc8aa5fbbab7cacf81972898 touched ImagingStudy for #FHIR-20166 and related imaging issues, but the active StructureDefinition source had already been reworked in commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 to use the LOINC download URL requested by the original resolution. Commit ff419bb74181109e1a82f78d27d5e839c9ca3b54 then changed that binding to the canonical LOINC value set URL from the later Jira comments.
additional_context: The 2019-2020 terminology Zulip thread linked from Jira confirmed the canonical URI and discussed making the LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook value set available for validation. Duplicate FHIR-33019 raised the same broken RSNA URL in R4 and explicitly points back to #20166. Later ImagingStudy remodels removed the procedureCode/ImagingProcedureCode binding from the active current resource altogether: current ImagingStudy.procedure is a Reference(Procedure). A stale copy of the old URL remains only in source/genomicstudy/imagingstudy.svg; source/fhir.ini has no active GenomicStudy entry, and the file is a generated-looking diagram artifact outside the active ImagingStudy source path.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change is needed because the current active ImagingStudy source no longer exposes the broken ImagingProcedureCode link, and editing an out-of-build generated SVG copy would not improve the current built specification.

related_jiras.note: Raised the same wrong ImagingProcedureCode URL in R4; its only Jira comment says to see FHIR-20166.
Later current-build procedure work leaves ImagingStudy.procedure as the performed Procedure reference, reinforcing that the old procedureCode value set binding is no longer active source.
